title: Points of a unit great-circle arc are unit vectors within arc length of the start
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let z, e ∈ ℝ^P with ‖z‖ = 1, ‖e‖ = 1 and ⟨z, e⟩ = 0, and let φ ∈ ℝ with φ ≥ 0. Then ‖cos φ · z + sin φ · e‖ = 1 and ‖cos φ · z + sin φ · e − z‖ ≤ φ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (z e : Euclid P) (φ : ℝ), ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ z e = 0 → 0 ≤ φ → ‖Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e‖ = 1 ∧ ‖Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e - z‖ ≤ φ
